EXTRAORDINARY

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: 2011/21. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/6/2011/HW/98. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: Lot No. E 4686 to E 4687(Lots 02) allotments in total extent of about 0.0701 Hectare,of land in Plan No. F.T.P. 4,Supplement No. 423, Sheet No. 726 and dated 04.11.2019 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveyor of Hambanthota District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the Grama Niladhari Divisions of No. 97, Elalla, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Hambanthota in Hambanthota District in the Southern Province. 01. Lot No. E 4686 Name of land: Gonnoruwa Yaya; Description: Garden, Contain a Mixed Cultivation; Claimant: State; Original

Claimant: Encroachment by K. G. Premasiri in Pahala Andarawewa; Extent: 0.0457 Hectare. 02. Lot No. E 4687 Name of land: -; Description: Road (RDA); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: -; Extent: 0.0244 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat office of Hambanthota on the 16th August 2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 09th August 2024, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
Kൺඎඌඁൺඅඒൺ Gൺඅൺඉඉൺඍඁඍඁං, Divisional Secretary, Hambanthota. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Hambanthota. 27th June 2024 EOG 07 - 0029
